summary: Bugsink is a self-hosted Sentry-compatible error/exception tracking server (Django + DRF): it ingests error events via a Sentry-compatible API, groups them into issues, tracks resolution/muting state, sends alerts through pluggable messaging backends and email, and supports teams/projects/membership with role-based access.
